revision.text: Throughout the Cicada puzzle series, users have worked hard to solve and document their progress, but occasionally some of that information gets lost, is not considered useful at the time, or old archived links stop working, or people who were around just forget - leading to missing information. The following is an incomplete list of missing or unknown information on the wiki. If you have information about one of these entries (an archived copy, or your memory of the event), please speak up in [https://discord.gg/eMmeaA9 Discord] or [[Talk:List_of_missing_information|the Talk page]]. ==2012== * The original /x/ thread. Two other threads from the same day have been archived: a [https://warosu.org/sci/thread/4217623 /sci/ thread] and a [https://imgur.com/ke78n /b/ thread]. * An archive of 845145127.com's source code, for both the countdown and the list of coordinates. Currently, we only have a [https://cicada-solvers.github.io/845145127.com partial archive]. * Did solvers manage to solve the "29 volumes" book code in 2012? If so, what was hosted on eq6emgv2ehsrix6t.onion? * What exactly was hosted on 33091839349.tk? Did it have a DNS TXT record? [https://imgur.com/a/5J7gN An image found] in IRC Logs from 2013 confirms that it had a TXT record: "http://i.imgur.com/NHYLD.jpg" * The content hosted on cginiziglyaobyph.onion (the second chance onion address) * Solvers [https://uncovering-cicada.fandom.com/wiki/The_second_chance_(2012)#cite_ref-4 reportedly] managed to doxx the two onions containing a email form (sq6wmgv2zcsrix6t.onion, cginiziglyaobyph.onion). How? What was found? * The mail sent by 3301 after submission of your email address to 'sq6wmgv2zcsrix6t.onion', which gave solvers a unique number to connect to 'sq6wmgv2zcsrix6t.onion/NUMBER' * The source code of 'sq6wmgv2zcsrix6t.onion/cgi-bin/get_email' after the form submission (a red text "Got it, thanks. We'll email you soon" would appear) * The main page of "sq6wmgv2zcsrix6t.onion" (How did it redirect to the '/cgi-bin/get_email' page?) * The source code of 'sq6wmgv2zcsrix6t.onion/NUMBER' ("Correct. We’ll email you." was displayed) * The email instructing solvers to go back to 'sq6wmgv2zcsrix6t.onion/NUMBER' to get the MIDI puzzle * The updated source code of 'sq6wmgv2zcsrix6t.onion/NUMBER' for the MIDI puzzle: did it only consist of the PGP-signed message? * The mail sent to the 2012 winner at around Monday, February 6th. "It explained that there would be no more puzzles. It gave directions to log on to a Tor hidden service, with a given username and password" * Information about the 2012 winners Tor service Entries found: * A copy of the "Everywhere" image containing the "29 Volumes" Outguess message. An [https://github.com/cicada-solvers/optimisticninja_cicada3301/blob/master/2012/03.subreddit/04.qr_codes/img/162667212858.jpg archived copy] was found on a private GitLab repository, set to public for a few weeks. The repository has been archived [https://github.com/cicada-solvers/optimisticninja_cicada3301 here]. The user who found this archive chose to delete their account, but we nonetheless thank them! * A copy of cicada.jpg, during the countdown phase. It contained the "Check back at 17:00 on Monday, 9 January 2012 UTC" Outguess message. This was found by the same user. Many thanks! [https://github.com/cicada-solvers/845145127.com/blob/master/countdown/cicada.jpg Archive] * The [[What_Happened_(2012)#The_RSA_Emails|PGP message for the 2nd part of 2012]] was altered for privacy reasons and does not publically verify despite being accepted as genuine privately. If anyone has a verifiable copy they want to publish, it would be appreciated. This was provided by [https://www.reddit.com/r/cicada/comments/mqnqps/2nd_chance_2012_puzzle_solve/ iBotPeaches on Reddit]! Thank you. ===2013=== * Screenshots or HTML archives of the 4chan thread. 3 threads are known to exist: two /b/ threads, and one /x/ thread. We only have text archives: http://pastebin.com/DDegZqLv ([https://web.archive.org/web/20140303042321/https://pastebin.com/DDegZqLv Archive]), http://pastebin.com/FfKH6ACw, http://pastebin.com/gX0Z5pme * A copy of the email that solvers received in 2013, after completing the [[What Happened Part 2 (2013)#The Questions|test on the fifth onion]], containing instructions to [[What Happened Part 2 (2013)#The Servers|build a specific TCP server]] ''with a valid PGP signature''. * ... ===2014=== * When [[What_Happened_Part_1_(2014)#The_Fifth_Onion|Onion5]] returned with a [[:File:Onion5portrait.jpg|portrait of Goya]], what was the HTML content of the webpage, and what was the filename of the portrait? * ... and many more to be added. ---- ---- ---- {{Template:Menu}} ==ONION 2 CICADA 3301 2014  Short (256 bytes) growing string)== At the end of Part 1, linked to above, we had a single resource: cu343l33nqaekrnw.onion [[File:A7kfqA2.png|thumb|346px]] This site will be refererd to as''''' onion 2''''' in wikia. *http://cu343l33nqaekrnw.onion/ *http://cu343l33nqaekrnw.onion.to/ *https://cu343l33nqaekrnw.tor2web.org/ To open the url as it is, download the [https://www.torproject.org/projects/torbrowser.html.en Tor Browser Bundle] . If this is not an option to you, you can visit the pages through the .onion.to or the .tor2web.org pages. This does not require the Tor Browser Bundle, however, you give up some anonymity doing this. As of 04:00 GMT 11.1.2014, http://cu343l33nqaekrnw.onion/ is not accesible anymore. Upon visiting the address, the following document was displayed, the string it contained grew gradually: <!--Patience is a virtue-->  Note the HTML comment that reads "Patience is a virtue". =='''Introduction'''== In 2012 this article popped up: http://www.losandesonline.cl/noticias/17643/11042012-pdi-advierte-sobre-nueva-modalidad-de-estafa-por-internet-a-traves-de-google.html
It accused a cybercriminal named "Necrome" to be a 3301's member. A translated version follows: Title: PID warns about a new type of Internet scam operated through Google Hackers advertised a fake page of bank on the search engine to get clients password data.
LOS ANDES. The Los Andes PID Brigade against Economic Crime warned the public, in particular users of Internet banking, on a new form of fraud operated using the well-known search engine google.
The head of that unit, Commissioner Marcelo Martínez (see enlarged photo) said a few weeks ago that the Metropolitan Bridec managed to establish the modus operandi of this hacker group named Cicada 3301.
The officer explained that to carry out these scams, hackers created fake bank websites which were advertised on Google. When a customers of such banking service wanted to access it, the fake virus-generated page would appear and the person would naively give out their access codes.
After obtaining the data, the cybercriminals accessed the users' real accounts and made money transfers.
Deputy Commissioner Martinez stated that as the result of this investigation, Enzo Alexander F.C., alias "Necrome", was arrested in Santiago. He was one of the members of this group, who also has a criminal record for two crimes of swindling.
He specified that the nationwide connections of this group are being investigated by the Cybercrime Brigade, "but the concreteness of this group operations should prompt local internet users to be careful when entering the pages of their banks through the Google search engine".
The officer said that victims of this type of scam should send a formal complaint to their bank to see whether the money can be returned "but if they were damaged, they should approach the nearest PDI unit to file a complaint". =='''3301's Response'''== 3301 responded with the following PGP-signed statement: {{PGP|message= -----BEGIN PGP SIGNED MESSAGE----- Hash: SHA1

From this perspective, his posting history makes sense. Furthermore his account was created in 2010 and he was last seen in 2021, making his story credible.
His second scam is documented by some news sources <ref>https://www.emol.com/noticias/nacional/2014/02/07/643668/hacker.html</ref>, saying it's his second sentence, the first one being for similar offences. Moreover the hacker's story told by news articles checks out with his sayings (prior to the articles).
